item.title: Generative AI Applied Scientist - Services Special Projects - Apple
item.description:
Summary
Join our Apple Services Special Projects Team and help build the next generation of GenAI solutions for millions of people, upholding the user privacy and security that Apple customers know and expect! Our team shapes the future of Apple's technologies, experiences, and services by building state-of-the-art models, infrastructure, and tools. If you want a collaborative environment where your expertise is valued, and you want to work on hard generative AI and retrieval problems that haven't been solved, this may be a role for you. We are especially interested in scientists who care about what and how models learn, and who use that understanding to make models more accurate, efficient, and robust.
Description
We are seeking a Machine Learning Scientist with a strong track record in applied AI research. You will train and improve the models behind large-scale search, retrieval, and ranking systems, and turn the latest research into production-ready models.
Minimum Qualifications
* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or MS with 5+ years of applied ML research experience * Strong deep learning and NLP fundamentals, with hands-on experience training and fine-tuning transformer models * Proficiency in PyTorch and strong Python programming skills * Experience with post-training, fine-tuning, or representation learning for large models * Experience designing rigorous experiments and evaluations, and analyzing model behavior * Demonstrated ability to turn research ideas into working systems
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience training embedding, retrieval, or reranking models (e.g., contrastive learning, late-interaction / ColBERT-style models, cross-encoders) * Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT) and preference optimization (RLHF, DPO) * Experience with distributed training (e.g., FSDP, DeepSpeed) and multi-GPU workloads * Experience with inference engines and serving frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, Triton) * Experience with model efficiency: quantization, pruning, distillation, or analysis of model internals * Experience with data-centric ML, such as data curation, data attribution, or training-data robustness * Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) * Publications at top venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ACL), and service as a reviewer or program committee member
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.
Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. item.title: Staff Research Data Scientist, Discover Experience - Google
item.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

### **Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 8 years of work experience with a PhD degree. * Experience with strategic analysis, metric reporting and executive presentations. * Experience with statistical modeling, survey design, data analysis and effective experimental design. * Ability to complete project work separately and work with cross-functional teams in a dynamic, fast-moving environment. * Ability to apply statistical training to real-world data. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to extract insights from data and telling convincing stories.
**About the job** -----------------
From the beginning, Google's mission has been to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful, and we consider it a privilege to be able to help. As technology continues to evolve, our commitment remains to help users in their journey to connect to helpful information more easily, leveraging technology to find new ways to satisfy users’ information needs.
Discover is a personalized feed that provides users with relevant and meaningful information based on their interests and our understanding of the world’s information, and is part of the broader Search organization at Google. Today, Discover is one of the world’s largest feed products, with more than 500M daily active users. Our vision is to create a feed that is “magically made for you and by you.” And our mission is to make it effortless for people to catch up on their interests by bringing together informative, entertaining content from the voices they care about.
Our role in Discover Data Science is to drive that mission with a data-informed strategy, identifying opportunities and accelerating execution. The Discover Feed Experiences team owns the user-facing (non-ranking) elements of the Discover product including experience, growth, AI integration into feed and more.
Join Google Search AI and work at the intersection of industry leading
global scale. We apply breakthrough research, leveraging models like Gemini, to launch high-impact products that help billions ask any question and get things done. If you want to drive the future of AI in Search and work with world-class experts to deliver tangible, global impact and continuous innovation, this is the place.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

item.title: Applied Scientist, Superconducting Digital and Cryogenic Control Electronics,Center for Quantum Computing, Physical Design and Simulation, Enabling Technologies - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is seeking an Applied Scientist to research and design cryogenic control hardware for large-scale quantum processors, with an emphasis on superconducting digital circuits. Controlling and reading out orders of magnitude more qubits than today's systems demands rethinking where classical control lives and what technology implements it; you will design and model superconducting digital logic (e.g., single-flux-quantum-family circuits) and related cryogenic electronics, evaluate them against the wiring, power, and thermal budgets of a scaled system, and co-design control approaches with the qubit devices they serve. You will carry designs from concept through simulation, layout, design review, and fabrication handoff, and your evaluations will inform which control-electronics directions the organization invests in.
Key job responsibilities
* Design and simulate superconducting digital circuits and cryogenic control/readout electronics for scalable qubit control * Develop and validate Josephson-junction circuit models, timing and margin analyses, and verification methodology for superconducting digital designs * Quantify system-level trade-offs — wiring count, power dissipation at each cryogenic stage, latency, footprint — across candidate control architectures, and communicate recommendations * Co-design control interfaces with qubit-device colleagues so control electronics and quantum devices are developed as one system * Deliver design artifacts through the organization's design-request and design-review processes, including tapeout-ready layouts and verification reports * Present results internally and, where appropriate, publish in peer-reviewed venues
About the team The Enabling Technologies team develops technologies and relationships facilitating scaling, including alternative quantum processor architectures, superconducting qubit device packaging, and cryogenic control device electronics. We work alongside a co-located quantum processor design team focused on current-generation devices; the two teams share design and review processes, and moving ideas between them is an explicit part of our charter.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* 3+ years of building models for business application experience * Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing * Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master's degree or above in a relevant field * Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals * Experience with circuit design and simulation * Familiarity with superconducting qubit control and readout — pulse generation, multiplexed readout, feedback latency requirements * Experience designing superconducting digital circuits (RSFQ/ERSFQ, adiabatic quantum phase parametron, or related single-flux-quantum logic families), including Josephson-junction circuit simulation and margin analysis * Experience with EDA flows for custom circuit design — schematic capture, layout, physical verification, and working against a process design kit
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development * Knowledge of cryogenic electronics more broadly: cryo-CMOS, low-temperature amplifiers and mixers, thermal and power budgeting across refrigerator stages * Experience with microwave engineering and signal integrity in dense cryogenic interconnect * Experience taking chips through fabrication and correlating measured circuit behavior with design models * Familiarity with quantum error correction decoding and the classical-processing requirements it places on control systems

item.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 48412
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Engine Security Behavioral Detection team, you will focus on building scalable ML systems to detect malicious behavior, automated play, and exploits using real-time or offline analysis to ensure platform safety and integrity. You will be at the forefront of protecting the Roblox community, developing sophisticated models that distinguish between legitimate player interactions and adversarial activities in a massive, dynamic 3D ecosystem. You will own the lifecycle of detection models, from identifying emerging threat patterns to deploying high-throughput inference services. Your work will bridge the gap between complex behavioral analysis and system-wide mitigation, ensuring that Roblox remains a safe and fair environment for millions of creators and players globally.

You Have:
* PhD or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field. * 4+ years of experience in ML engineering, specifically in behavior modeling, anomaly detection, or fraud detection. * Proficiency with time-series analysis, neural networks, or large-scale classification systems. * Experience training and deploying models on high-throughput, low-latency production systems. * Proficiency in Python (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and familiarity with big data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, or similar). * Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for platform integrity and security.
Job Expectations:
* Deliver high-impact ML solutions that directly improve platform security and trust. * Take ownership of model monitoring and retuning strategies to counter adaptive adversary tactics. * Provide technical guidance on best practices for feature engineering in adversarial domains. * Maintain operational excellence, ensuring reliability and scalability of detection services.

item.title: Lead Data Scientist, Marketplace Intelligence & Optimization - Comcast
item.description:
Universal Ads, a part of Comcast, enables any brand, of any size, to seamlessly make and buy commercials across premium video reaching new qualified audiences at scale. Universal Ads combines premium and brand-safe video content directly from the most influential media companies with the ease and familiarity of social ad buying. It is your one-stop shop for high-quality video ads delivering performance and unmatched scale. **Job Summary**
We're looking for an experienced Lead Data Scientist to build marketplace intelligence across Universal Ads, uncovering opportunities to improve supply efficiency, delivery performance, and marketplace growth. You'll work closely with Product, Publisher Partnerships, and Engineering to analyze the full advertising supply funnel, diagnose constraints and auction inefficiencies, and quantify opportunities to unlock incremental inventory, advertiser spend, and performance. Your insights will directly inform publisher strategy, supply investments, and product optimization priorities. The ideal candidate combines deep analytical and modeling expertise with a strong understanding of programmatic advertising, auction dynamics, and marketplace economics. This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role with significant influence over Universal Ads' supply strategy, optimization roadmap, and marketplace growth.
**Job Description**
**Responsibilities:**
* Analyze and build performance monitoring for our end-to-end advertising supply funnel, from available inventory and bid eligibility through auction wins, delivered impressions, and advertiser outcomes. * Identify and quantify marketplace inefficiencies, including publisher restrictions, creative eligibility, deal configurations, auction competition, pricing floors, and drivers of campaign delivery. * Partner with product to develop predictive models and analytical frameworks to identify delivery risks and opportunities to improve bidding, pacing, and inventory allocation. * Develop supply and reach forecasting models to estimate inventory availability, campaign delivery capacity, and potential advertiser spend. * Partner with Publisher Partnerships to identify high-value inventory, evaluate supply-demand gaps, and quantify the incremental revenue and performance potential of new publishers, markets, and supply integrations. * Establish marketplace health metrics to monitor supply utilization, auction efficiency, delivery performance, and emerging growth opportunities. * Translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations that inform product optimization priorities, publisher investments, and marketplace strategy.
**Employees at all levels are expected to:**
* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job. * Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services. * Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences. * Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas. * Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers. * Drive results and growth. * Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead. * Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics - Roblox
item.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.
Why Marketplace Economics?
* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users. * **Complex markets, rich signals:** Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response. * **Strategic ownership:** Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace. * **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.
You will:
* **Design Economic Systems**: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem. * **Master Pricing & Supply Response**: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies. * **Spearhead UGC Category Launches**: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity. * **Apply Deep Causal Inference**: Build rigorous observational and experimental causal inference solutions to isolate the true impact of market interventions on creator success and platform economics. * **Drive Strategy**: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization.
You have (at least some of) the following:
* **6+ years** of industry or research experience in Data Science or Economics, specifically within large-scale UGC content platforms, pricing, marketplace mechanism design, or creator economies. * **Deep Methodological Expertise** in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL), alongside a deep theoretical understanding of econometrics and mechanism design. * **Marketplace Intuition** with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health. * **Executive Communication & Leadership** skills to distill high-dimensional economic problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences. * **An Advanced Degree** (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

item.title: Applied Scientist, Search Ranking and Exploration - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Amazon's Search team creates ML algorithms that connect customers around the world with products that delight them. We harness machine learning at Amazon's scale to make the customer experience easier and smoother. Our impact is large. For example, if your innovations save even 1 minute per customer per year, then for every 100 million customers, you save approximately 190 years of human effort.
Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on the Search L1 Ranking team, you will build search ranking models that work for thousands of product types, billions of queries, and hundreds of millions of customers spread around the world. You will find the next set of big improvements to ranking, leverage large datasets to understand the complexities of customer behavior, and build ML models that work at Amazon scale. Amazon's Search ranking relies on efficient early stage ranking followed by power final stage ranking models. this role focuses on efficient models for early stage ranking phase, and techniques to personalize these models and optimize them automatically.
A day in the life Our primary focus is improving search ranking systems. On a day-to-day this means building ML models, analyzing data from your recent A/B tests, and collaborating with partner teams on joint goals. We leverage agentic workflows to improve our scientific velocity, and partner closely with SDEs to bring our ideas to production. You will shape the future of search ranking by presenting proposals to Amazon's business and tech leaders.
About the team We are a team consisting of ML scientists and software engineers. Our interests span machine learned ranking models, distilled LLMs for efficient inference, personalization techniques to refine the ranking of our models, reinforcement learning to bring the benefits of exploration to search ranking, and infrastructure to make it all happen at scale and efficiently.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------

item.title: Sr. Data Scientist - AppFolio Inc
item.description:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.
We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist to drive the product analytics and experimentation strategy for AppFolio's Resident experience business. You'll help elevate the renter experience and protect millions of people by driving growth across our resident-facing offerings—including **FolioGuard renters' insurance, resident rewards programs, and comprehensive resident benefit packages**. You will partner with product, engineering, design, and other data scientists to solve challenging problems and propel one of our fastest-growing business areas to greater heights.
### **Your impact**
* **Optimize the resident journey:** Map, measure, and refine end-to-end enrollment and purchase funnels to drive measurable adoption of resident insurance, rewards, and benefit offerings. * **Scale experimentation rigor:** Build and implement standard causal inference and A/B testing frameworks that validate product hypotheses originated by both product teams and AI agents. * **Drive retention & sustained engagement:** Develop user behavioral segmentation models to uncover product-market fit signals, curb cancellations, and lift insurance renewal and benefit utilization rates. * **Accelerate analytical velocity with AI:** Integrate modern AI developer workflows (such as agentic coding assistants and pipeline automation) into team operations while establishing rigorous auditing and QA practices. * **Build reusable data assets:** Architect standard metric layers and cross-product analytical frameworks that serve as single sources of truth for resident adoption and financial metrics. * **Multiply team capabilities:** Elevate data science standards across the organization through active design/code reviews, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing on complex statistical problems.
### **Qualifications**
* Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Design and Business leaders to translate analytical findings into strategic product decisions. * Deep expertise in user behavioral data, cohort retention modeling, conversion funnel optimization, and designing complex A/B or causal experiments. * Hands-on experience building, transforming, and validating production data pipelines and creating centralized metric layers. * Proven experience building interactive decision apps, dashboards, or reporting workflows using modern stacks (Hex, Streamlit, Quarto, or comparable data app frameworks). * Familiarity with data modeling tools like dbt, and experience working in dual-sided marketplaces, consumer workflow software, B2B2C, FinTech/InsurTech, or PropTech environments is a plus.
### **Must have**
* 6+ years of data team experience specializing in product analytics, user behavioral data, and statistical analysis. * Advanced proficiency in SQL and strong programming skills in Python and/or R, with deep familiarity querying relational database structures and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred). * Proven track record designing, analyzing, and scaling A/B testing and causal inference frameworks. * Demonstrated hands-on use of AI coding agents and agentic developer workflows (e.g., Claude Code, Model Context Protocol integrations, or custom skills) to accelerate analyses and automate data workflows, paired with a disciplined framework for auditing and validating AI-generated code. * Strong executive communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to distill complex statistical concepts into clear insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
### **Nice to Have**
* Data modeling experience using dbt * Experience building data pipelines, tooling, or automation * Experience in one or more of the following:
* B2C marketplaces * Customer workflow products (customer input data) * B2B SaaS products * Marketing software products * Real estate sector or PropTech (specifically around resident benefits, insurance, or rewards)
### **Location**
Find out more about our locations by visiting our site.
All late-stage candidates complete an in-person meeting with an AppFolian as part of our hiring process.
### **Compensation & Benefits**
The compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is: $138,400 - $173,000 base pay. The actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity.
Please note that compensation is just one aspect of a comprehensive Total Rewards package. The compensation range listed here does not include additional benefits or any discretionary bonuses you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type.
Regular full-time employees are eligible for benefits - see here.
**About AppFolio** AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. For more information about AppFolio, visit appfolio.com.
**Why AppFolio**
**Grow** | We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves.
**Learn** | We partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. We're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best-in-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills.
**Impact** | We are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities.
**Connect** | We excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. We create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed.
**Paddle as One.**
Learn more at appfolio.com/company/careers
***Statement of Equal Opportunity***
At AppFolio, we value diversity in backgrounds and perspectives and depend on it to drive our innovative culture. That’s why we’re a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we believe that our products, our teams, and our business are stronger because of it. This means that no matter what race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, or medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by law, you’re always welcome at AppFolio.
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process for a disability, pregnancy-related condition, or religious practice, please contact us at peopleoperations@appfolio.com or (805) 284-0834. You do not need to use any particular wording.

item.title: Data Scientist, Strategic Finance - Rippling
item.description:
**About Rippling** ------------------
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
**About the role** ------------------
As a Data Scientist on the Strategic Finance team at Rippling, you will combine advanced analytics, forecasting, and hands-on development of AI tools to inform company-wide business decisions. You will partner with stakeholders across Go-to-Market, Customer Experience, and R&D Finance to uncover insights and build forecasting models that shape financial targets and planning across Rippling’s product suites. You will also serve as an AI expert within Finance, building workflows and helping the team adopt new tools that fundamentally improve how it analyzes data and makes decisions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong analytical skills, business judgment, and a desire to shape how Finance works.
**What you will do** --------------------
* Lead analytics for company-wide planning cycles, partnering with Finance leaders to shape forecasts, financial targets, and resource allocation decisions * Drive the adoption of AI across Finance, combining hands-on development with coaching to transform how the team conducts analysis, generates insights, and makes decisions * Own automated forecasting models for key business metrics, including customer retention and expansion * Define and deeply understand critical business metrics such as net dollar retention and customer acquisition cost * Build high-quality data infrastructure to support accurate analyses of business performance across sales, marketing, R&D and customer experience * Serve as a trusted strategic partner to Rippling’s Finance executives, offering data-driven insights to support our continued strong ARR growth
**What you will need** ----------------------
* 4+ years of experience in data science and analytics – proven ability to use data science methods to drive business impact, particularly in B2B SaaS or fintech industries * Master’s degree or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, Econ, Math, Business Analytics, or other related fields * Proficiency in data analysis tools – hands-on experience with Python, SQL, dbt, Databricks, and other data analysis tools. You should be comfortable performing statistical analysis, running queries, and building models * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills –you will be expected to turn complex data into actionable insights that influence strategic business decisions * Curiosity and initiative to experiment with new AI tools and apply them to improve workflows * Strong communication skills – you should excel in communicating technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders * Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive projects end to end * Ability to operate autonomously in an ambiguous, fast‑paced environment
**Preferred qualifications include prior experience in** --------------------------------------------------------
* End-to-end model lifecycle, including development, backtesting, deployment, and monitoring * Time series forecasting with limited historical data * Financial modeling, gained through Strategic Finance, Investment Banking, or close partnership with Finance teams
**Additional Information** --------------------------
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

item.title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Product Data Science (Mailchimp) - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
The Mailchimp Product Data Science team turns product and customer data into insights and models that shape Mailchimp's product strategy. We work as thought partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Pricing to drive data-driven decisions through experimentation, causal measurement, and deep customer analytics.
We're looking for a Senior Staff Data Scientist to be an analytical leader for Mailchimp's product growth. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you'll set the measurement vision across the full customer journey: sign-up and onboarding, activation, conversion to paid, engagement, and long-term retention. The role raises the scientific bar for how we experiment and size opportunities, and it shapes product and business strategy at the senior leadership level. It's also hands-on, focused on the highest-leverage problems and on helping the team adopt AI-native workflows that let us move faster.
This role is based in New York, NY / Mountain View, CA / Atlanta, GA under Intuit's hybrid model, 3 days per week in office.
**Responsibilities**
* **Influence product strategy:** Be a strategic thought partner to senior Product and business leaders. Shape Mailchimp's growth roadmap with deep dives into customer segmentation, onboarding and activation funnels, feature adoption, pricing and packaging, and retention. * **Set the analytics vision:** Own the measurement framework, north-star and guardrail metrics, and leading indicators for the self-serve customer journey, from free and trial sign-ups to paid conversion, bookings, and recurring revenue. * **Lead experimentation and causal measurement:** Drive a culture of rigorous, iterative experimentation. Design complex tests (A/B/n, sequential, holdouts, long-running), apply Bayesian and frequentist inference, and use causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, and synthetic control where randomized tests aren't possible. * **Size and prioritize opportunities:** Build opportunity-sizing and forecasting frameworks that turn product initiatives into incremental revenue impact, accounting for retention curves and the winner's curse, so leadership can prioritize investment. * **Uncover growth opportunities:** Use first-principles thinking and exploratory analysis to find untapped levers across the funnel, including in-product onboarding, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and plan upgrades. * **Shape the AI-native roadmap:** Partner with Product and Engineering to measure AI-powered features in Mailchimp. Build ML and LLM-based solutions such as propensity models, personalization, and automated insights for hard product problems. * **Raise the scientific bar:** Build reusable analytical frameworks, governed metric definitions, and self-serve tools that improve decision-making at scale. Champion strong instrumentation and data quality. * **Lead and mentor:** Be a technical lead for the Product Data Science team. Coach and grow senior and staff data scientists, review their methods, and model executive-ready storytelling.
**Qualifications**
* 8+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, with a proven record of driving product strategy and measurable business impact. * Experience in B2B SaaS, subscription, or freemium/self-serve businesses strongly preferred. Familiarity with marketing technology or small-business customers is a plus. * Expert SQL and data modeling skills on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery preferred), plus advanced Python or R. * Deep expertise in experimental design and causal inference, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor against speed of decision-making. * Track record of sizing opportunities and forecasting revenue impact, including funnel, cohort, and retention analysis. * Hands-on experience applying machine learning (classification, regression, uplift or propensity modeling) and LLM/GenAI workflows to real product problems. * Proficient in an AI-native data science tech stack (for example, Claude, Cursor, or Codex with MCPs, CLIs, and APIs) and eager to keep building how the team works with AI. * Excellent executive communication. You turn complex analysis into clear narratives and recommendations, and you've influenced senior leaders across Product, Marketing, and Finance. * Experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional work where the question, metric definitions, or methodology have to be set before the analysis can start. * Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership of other data scientists. * Bachelor's or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Operations Research, or equivalent practical experience.
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.
The expected base pay range for this position is:
New York $210,500 - $284,500

item.title: Staff Data Scientist - GoFundMe
item.description:
**Want to help us help others? We're hiring!**
GoFundMe is the world's most powerful community for good, dedicated to helping people help each other. By uniting individuals and nonprofits in one place, GoFundMe makes it easy and safe for people to ask for help and support causes, for themselves and each other. Together, our community has raised more than $40 billion since 2010.
We're looking for a **Staff Data Scientist** to help shape how GoFundMe uses data science to grow our impact across marketing, growth, and product. This role will serve as a senior individual contributor who leads high-impact workstreams across go-to-market and product surfaces, with a primary focus on helping the business make better decisions about audience strategy, acquisition, retention, personalization, experimentation, and investment efficiency.
You will partner closely with leaders across Data, Marketing, Product, Growth, Finance, and Engineering to define technical strategy, build scalable measurement and modeling frameworks, accelerate impact through modern AI-enabled workflows, and translate complex analyses into clear recommendations that improve outcomes for our users, customers, and business.
**Candidates considered for this role will be located in the San Francisco Bay Area.** **There will be an in-office requirement of 3x a week.**
**The Job**

**You**

**Preferred**

**Why you'll love it here**

item.title: Senior Data Scientist - PayPal
item.description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

This job will lead the development and implementation of advanced data science models and algorithms. You will work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves driving best practices in data science, ensuring data quality, and mentoring junior scientists.

item.description:

At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best Data Intelligence Platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.
Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, California to a global organization with over 1000 employees. Thousands of organizations, from small to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the world.
Our engineering teams build highly technical products that fulfill real, important needs in the world. We constantly push the boundaries of data and AI technology, while simultaneously operating with the resilience, security and scale that is critical to making customers successful on our platform.
We develop and operate one of the largest scale software platforms. The fleet consists of millions of virtual machines, generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data per day. At our scale, we regularly observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above.
As a Data Scientist on the Data Team, you will help build a data-driven culture within Databricks by helping solve product and business challenges. The Data team also functions as an in-house, production "customer" that dogfoods Databricks and drives the future direction of the products.

item.title: Lead Data Scientist – Cyber Security Operations Center - Salesforce
item.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category
Software Engineering
Job Details
**About Salesforce** Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
**The Experience** The Data Science & Analytics team in the Salesforce Cyber Security Operations Center seeks an experienced, visionary, and driven Lead Data Scientist to help protect our customers and identify malicious activity on our platforms. We explore, invent, build, and scale advanced capabilities to secure the Salesforce platform. We leverage AI, machine learning, and contemporary data techniques to advance behavior- and signature-based detection mechanisms.
As a technical leader on a growing and highly visible team, you will establish technical direction, architect end-to-end detection frameworks, and partner with executive, threat, product, and engineering teams to deliver autonomous defenses that operate at cloud scale—evolving through agentic-based monitoring, testing, and continuous improvement.
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Strategic & Technical Leadership: Define the technical vision, methodology, and roadmap for data science and AI-driven detection capabilities within the CSOC. * Architecture & Delivery: Architect, build, and oversee the execution of proofs-of-concept for novel threat detection models, ensuring seamless transition into high-throughput, scalable production software. * Cross-Functional Influence: Lead partnerships with incident response, threat intelligence, detection engineering, and product security teams to identify detection gaps and model evolving adversary behavior. * AI & Agentic Systems Ownership: Champion, design, and maintain enterprise AI-driven capabilities, including agentic monitoring systems, automated threat correlation, and continuous model feedback loops. * Mentorship & Technical Governance: Mentor senior and junior data scientists, establish best practices for code quality, model governance, testing, and ML pipeline reliability. * Executive Communication: Translate complex machine learning models and security signals into actionable insights and strategic proposals for security leadership, engineers, and non-technical stakeholders.
**You're Our Person If...**
* 8+ years of industry experience in applied data science, machine learning, or AI engineering (or 6+ years with a relevant Master's or Ph.D.). * 3+ years in a technical leadership capacity (e.g., Lead Data Scientist, Tech Lead, or Principal Individual Contributor) owning project lifecycles from ideation to production. * Deep expertise in applied statistics, probability, and advanced machine learning techniques (deep learning, sequence modeling, anomaly detection, NLP/LLMs). * Demonstrated experience architecting and deploying ML pipelines and models over large-scale datasets (multi-terabyte or petabyte scale). * Production-level programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala, along with fluency in big data frameworks (e.g., Spark, PySpark, Flink) and modern MLOps ecosystems. * Proven track record of guiding cross-functional technical decisions and mentoring engineering and data science team members. * Exceptional strategic communication skills, with the ability to influence technical roadmaps and articulate complex concepts to leadership.
**Even Better If...**
* Domain expertise in Cybersecurity, specifically in threat propagation, signal correlation, security log analysis (SIEM, EDR, network flows), and behavioral threat modeling. * Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI systems, automated reasoning, or generative AI workflows in high-consequence operational environments. * Experience in other high-throughput, low-latency domains involving pattern recognition and behavioral analysis (e.g., quantitative finance, high-frequency trading, genomics, or fraud detection).
**About You**
* Technical Leader & Strategist: You possess a deep passion for AI and data, combined with a proven track record of converting complex security challenges into scalable data science initiatives. You bridge rigorous statistical theory with high-impact business and operational security outcomes. * Innovator & Architect: You thrive on researching, evaluating, and architecting cutting-edge techniques in generative AI, agentic workflows, data mining, and machine learning, driving innovations from initial concept through production deployment. * Force Multiplier: You are a natural collaborator and mentor who elevates those around you. You partner fluently with threat intelligence experts to decipher emerging attack vectors and collaborate with principal software engineers to set the architectural standards for production security algorithms. * You wanna stop bad guys: You enjoy creating chaos for cyber attackers and want to disrupt their operations.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist, Algorithm, Lyft Biz - Lyft
item.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
Data Science is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. Data Scientists at Lyft operate in dynamic environments, moving quickly to build the world’s best transportation solutions.We tackle a wide range of challenges - from shaping long-term business strategy with data, to making critical short-term decisions, to developing algorithms and models that power both internal systems and customer-facing products.
Lyft Business builds products that help organizations move the people who matter most - employees, customers, patients, and guests - easily and efficiently. Our offerings include Business Travel, Lyft Pass, and Concierge (for healthcare and non-healthcare rides), enabling companies to manage transportation at scale through APIs, integrations (e.g., Concur, Expensify), and dedicated tools. These platforms power high-impact B2B use cases across corporate travel, healthcare access, customer experience, and community programs.
We are seeking a **Senior Data Scientist** to lead technical initiatives across the entire Lyft Business product suite. In this role, you will shape the technical vision, define algorithmic roadmaps, and drive execution for data science projects that accelerate growth, improve operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our enterprise partners. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Go-to-Market teams to build production ML models, experimentation frameworks, and advanced analytics that inform strategy and power product innovation.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with direct influence on Lyft’s enterprise offerings. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in algorithm development, machine learning, causal inference, and experimentation, alongside strong business acumen in B2B contexts and a proven track record of technical leadership in fast-paced, cross-functional environments.
**Responsibilities**
* Technical Leadership: Lead complex Machine Learning, AI, and causal inference initiatives across Lyft Business products (Business Travel, Lyft Pass, Concierge) in ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces. * End-to-End Modelling: Own the complete lifecycle of algorithmic solutions—from problem formulation, data exploration, and feature engineering to deployment, monitoring, and iteration. * Production Deployment: Partner closely with Engineering to build and scale production-grade ML systems, real-time inference services, batch pipelines, and feature stores. * Experimentation & Rigor: Define offline/online metrics, evaluation frameworks, and A/B testing strategies to ensure algorithms are reliable, fair, and aligned with business outcomes. * System Optimization: Continually improve model performance across latency, accuracy, cost, and reliability using advanced tuning and scientific rigor. * Algorithmic Innovation: Drive scientific excellence by introducing modern techniques in ML, optimization, reinforcement learning, or graph-based methods to unlock new product capabilities. * Cross-Functional Influence: Translate complex business challenges into concrete algorithmic solutions in close collaboration with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Science teams. * Mentorship & Quality Bar: Mentor junior and mid-level scientists, providing technical guidance, conducting modeling critiques, and contributing to Lyft's broader ML standards and tooling.
**Experience**
* Master’s or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Optimization, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent applied experience) * Industry Background: 5+ years of hands-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining production machine learning models and optimization systems. * Core Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of supervised/unsupervised learning, ranking/decisioning systems, probabilistic modeling, and causal inference. * Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python, modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn), and distributed data systems (Spark, Snowflake, Databricks). * Production ML Systems: Hands-on experience building end-to-end ML architectures, including online/batch pipelines, feature engineering, and automated monitoring frameworks. * Experimental Design: Demonstrated track record of designing rigorous experimentation strategies, A/B tests, and offline/online validation methodologies. * Domain Ownership: Proven ability to independently drive multi-project algorithmic scopes and navigate technical ambiguity from ideation to delivery.Communication & Leadership: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, alongside a history of mentoring peers and raising technical bars.
**Benefits:**
* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled * Mental health benefits * Family building benefits * Child care and pet benefits * 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future * In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off * 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible * Subsidized commuter benefits * Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership
Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule - Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid
The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $148,000 - $185,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Search & Assistant, Prime Video Personalization and Discovery - Prime Video & Amazon MGM Studios
item.description:
**Description** Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment through cutting-edge AI? Prime Video’s technology teams are redefining the digital video experience at scale.
As a Principal Applied Scientist at Prime Video, you will be a technical and strategic leader responsible for inventing, developing, and deploying groundbreaking AI solutions that power personalized, relevant, and delightful experiences for hundreds of millions of global customers. You will help shape the vision and direction of key ML systems that support Prime Video’s mission to deliver AI-powered customer experiences.
Prime Video is a fast-growing business with new customer problems emerging every day, and this is the moment to rethink how customers find what they love. We recently launched a new search stack built on LLMs and generative retrieval, and we are now moving from traditional recommender systems to experiences powered by foundation models. You will join a research-driven team that is building and publishing at the same time. This year our scientists submitted work to SIGIR, RecSys, ICLR, CIKM, and ACL, and we host summer interns who work on these problems with us.
Key job responsibilities
* Lead the strategy for applying foundation models and LLMs across Prime Video search and discovery, evolving the current systems rather than rebuilding them * Advance LLM-based and generative retrieval approaches across search and discovery * Make LLM-powered experiences more efficient and scalable through model fine-tuning, distillation, and inference optimization, and right-size each solution to the problem * Invent, prototype, and productionize large-scale AI solutions using deep learning, generative AI, reinforcement learning, and optimization techniques * Explore and deliver agentic workflows and Gen AI customer experiences, including through model fine-tuning approaches * Provide technical leadership and influence product vision by partnering closely with engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders * Design and lead high-impact A/B tests and data analyses that validate hypotheses and guide product direction * Raise the technical bar across science and engineering through mentorship (including of interns), design reviews, and collaboration * Publish impactful research internally and externally at top-tier venues such as SIGIR, RecSys, ACL, and similar conferences
A day in the life
In your first year, you will lead how LLMs power the search and discovery experience across Prime Video. You won’t be starting from scratch. You will grow and evolve systems that are already in production, making them smarter, faster, and more efficient. You will decide where a large model adds real customer value and where a leaner approach, such as distillation, fine-tuning, or smaller models, is the better choice. Your work will be highly visible to senior leadership and will directly shape how millions of customers discover content.
**About The Team** Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is dedicated to creating a highly personalized content discovery experience that not only delights our customers but also drives both short-and long-term business goals. Our scope includes personalized recommendations, search, marketing, and the advanced machine learning technology and infrastructure that underpins these experiences. Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI.
**Basic Qualifications**
* 5+ years of hands-on work in predictive modeling and analysis experience * PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field * Experience working in predictive modeling and analysis * Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience with leading experienced scientists as well as having a record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a career track in a business environment
**Preferred Qualifications**
* 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience * Knowledge of problem solving, algorithm design and complexity analysis * Experience creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art * Have peer-reviewed scientific contributions in premier journals and conferences

item.description:
**Description** Amazon Industrial Robotics is on a mission to redefine the future of
automation — and we're looking for exceptional talent to help lead the way.
We are building the next generation of advanced robotic systems that
seamlessly blend cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and novel
mechanical design to create adaptable, intelligent automation solutions
capable of operating safely alongside humans in dynamic, real-world
environments.
At Amazon Industrial Robotics, we leverage the power of machine learning,
artificial intelligence, and advanced robotics to solve some of the most
complex operational challenges at a scale unlike anywhere else in the world.
Our fleet of robots spans hundreds of facilities globally, working in
sophisticated coordination to deliver on our promise of customer excellence
— and we're just getting started.
As a Sr. Applied Scientist in Robot Perception, you will be at the forefront of
this transformation. You will develop and deploy state-of-the-art perception
algorithms that enable robots to truly understand and interact with the
physical world — bridging the gap between theoretical research and realworld
impact. Bringing deep expertise in Computer Vision and a nuanced
understanding of the capabilities and limitations of modern Vision-Language
Models (VLMs), you will innovate boldly and push the boundaries of what's
possible. Our vision for the Perception layer is ambitious: to enable seamless,
intelligent interaction between the user, the robot, and its environment.
This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of deep learning, large
language models, and robotics — contributing to research that doesn't just
advance the field, but reshapes it. You will collaborate with world-class teams
pioneering breakthroughs in dexterous manipulation, locomotion, and humanrobot
interaction, all at an unprecedented scale.

Design, develop, and deploy perception algorithms for robotics systems,
including object detection, segmentation, tracking, depth estimation, and
scene understanding
* Lead research initiatives in computer vision, sensor fusion and 3D
perception
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including robotics engineers,

technical excellence
* Define and track key metrics to measure perception system performance

Train ML models for deployment in simulation and real-world robots,
identify and document their limitations post-deployment
* Drive technical discussions within your team and with key stakeholders to

* Actively contribute to brainstorming sessions on adjacent topics, bringing
fresh perspectives that help peers grow and succeed — and in doing so,
build lasting trust across the team
* Mentor team members while maintaining significant hands-on
contribution to technical solutions

item.title: Staff Data Scientist– Pricing Science - CSC Generation
item.description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.
**Reports to** : Director of Finance and Business Intelligence
**Location:** Remote — US or Canada
**About The Role** As our **Staff Data Scientist** , you will design and ship **production pricing systems** such as demand forecasting, price elasticity modeling, dynamic pricing and the experimentation infrastructure needed to measure whether they actually work.
This is a hard, high-stakes problem: your models will directly influence margin and revenue decisions across a portfolio of brands operating at scale. You will own the full arc from framing ambiguous business problems as well-defined ML tasks through to monitoring models that hold up in production.
At six months, success looks like at least one pricing model shipped to production with measurable business impact and an experimentation framework in place that your stakeholders trust. If you have spent time building pricing systems from the ground up, not just consuming them, and you care deeply about rigorous causal inference and honest model evaluation, this role was written for you.
**What You'll Do**
* Design and build production ML systems for pricing, demand forecasting, and related revenue problems * Frame ambiguous business problems as well-defined ML tasks with clear success criteria and measurable outcomes * Set the standard for model evaluation, validation, and monitoring — including knowing when CV metrics are misleading and when holdout testing is the only honest answer * Build robust predictive models across classification, regression, time series, and causal inference * Identify and prevent data leakage, overfitting, and other failure modes before they reach production * Design and analyze experiments to measure causal impact of pricing decisions * Debug models that fail in production — understand why they fail, not just that they do * Translate model limitations, uncertainty, and risk clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders * Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to ensure ML solutions solve real problems
**Required Qualifications**
* 7+ years of applied ML / data science experience with a track record of production systems that delivered measurable business impact. * Deep experience in pricing, demand forecasting, or revenue optimization — you have built these models end-to-end, not just consumed them. * Expert-level Python and SQL. * Deep understanding of ML fundamentals beyond API-level usage, including model evaluation, validation, and failure mode diagnosis. * Strong grounding in causal inference and experimental design, including the ability to distinguish correlation from causal result. * Ability to work with messy, real-world data and make pragmatic tradeoffs under ambiguity. * Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (GCP/Vertex AI or AWS/SageMaker). * MS or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, marketplace, or pricing-intensive industries such as airlines, ride-sharing, or fintech.
**Why Join** The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

item.title: Data Scientist - Structure Therapeutics
item.description:
Structure Therapeutics develops life‐changing medicines for patients using advanced structure‐based and computational drug discovery technology. The company’s platform combines the latest advancements in visualization of molecular interactions, computational chemistry, and data integration to design orally available, superior small molecule medicines that overcome current limitations of biologic and peptide drugs. We are advancing a clinical‐stage pipeline of differentiated treatments focused on chronic diseases with high unmet need, including cardiovascular, metabolic, and pulmonary conditions.
Structure Therapeutics is led by an experienced group of international drug innovators and financed by top-tier global life sciences investors. The company completed an initial public offering (IPO) in February 2023. With offices in California and Shanghai, Structure Therapeutics has the benefit of being at the center of life science innovation in both the US and China and capitalizing on the strengths of each geographic location.
**Position Summary** We are seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist with strong software engineering skills to join the Biometrics and Data Management group. This role will focus on advancing the current platform and developing novel and scalable data science tools to support evolving business needs. As a key contributor in a multidisciplinary environment, you will work closely with clinical scientists, biostatisticians, data managers, statistical programmers, and other stakeholders to design, implement and deploy robust data-driven solutions that accelerate decision-making and improve patient outcomes. In addition to modeling and analytics work, you will contribute to building production-grade tools and frameworks that extend the capabilities of the current internal platforms.
**Job Responsibilities**
* Enhance the existing platforms by contributing to the development, validation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. * Develop and validate data science tools for clinical research, and trial optimization. * Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and reliability of analytical solutions through software engineering best practices (e.g., testing, documentation, CI/CD pipeline).
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. * Minimum of 10 years of Data Science experience with a Bachelor’s degree, 8 years with a Master’s, or 4 years with a Ph.D., including at least 3 years of hands-on experience developing production-grade software in programming languages such as Python or R. * Demonstrated understanding of software architecture, performance optimization and validation. * Strong expertise in Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch). * Familiar with data visualization tools such as ggplot2. Plotly, Matplotlib or Seaborn. * Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. * Experienced with Github.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s or Ph.D degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. * Experience with cloud-computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (e.g., Docker). * Experience with creating Large Language Models (LLMs) and GenAI based solution in production environment. * Experienced in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines.
Travel Required: Connection week
Structure Therapeutics Inc. is an Equal-Opportunity Employer.
Structure Therapeutics is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. For this role, the anticipated base pay range is $148K-$182K. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.
At Structure, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Structure Therapeutics also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, unlimited PTO, and a number of paid holidays including winter shutdown.
